title: Deliver real retained Core editing in Editor
summary: The retained Core editing engine has no product export/build or revision-bound render/geometry result for Editor consumption. Current Creator Preview uses a different Core shaping/layout path and suppresses Enter. A Core-to-Editor result contract and authored-paragraph versus simulated-field mapping must be resolved before claiming this is retained-session integration; simply enabling Enter or reshaping from browser text would not meet the request.
stopConditions: Acceptance criteria satisfied; no additional proof
